Plugin.Name: Unraid Secretary Office
Plugin.Overview:
Backup and restore for your Unraid server: snapshots, database dumps, every app and VM with its configuration, encrypted offsite to S3, a NAS or a second server. Plus a media cache for Emby, Jellyfin and Plex, a smart mover and a security watch.
Backup: scheduled ZFS/btrfs snapshots, database dumps, one package per app and VM including XML, UEFI/TPM and templates. Optional encrypted offsite backup to S3 storage or a NAS (built on Kopia), or two Unraid servers keep each other's backups — only the changes travel, over your own network or the office's own Tailscale network (no port forwarding).
Restore: databases, folders, whole shares, single files at any depth, templates and VMs — from the local snapshots, the offsite copy or the partner; the flash archive to download. What gets replaced is set aside, never deleted, and restore drills on throwaway copies prove the backups really come back. Every page shows protection by what the backups really made, not by the settings, and how long each copy is kept. A run with warnings names them in its notification.
Snapshots: ZFS, btrfs and VM snapshots with schedules and simple retention.
Media cache & mover: what people watch next in Emby, Jellyfin or Plex is fetched onto the fast pool within a budget in GB, so the array disks can sleep; who is watching what, live. The oldest files move to the array only when the pool is above your limit, and a live picture shows the joint run.
Security & tidying: how securely the server stands, a watch book of anything unusual (sign-ins, plugins, far more data pulled than usual, UniFi and MikroTik routers too), every log in one place, and unused data cleared into a storeroom instead of deleted.
Requires Unraid 7.3.2 or a newer 7.x (Unraid 8 is not supported yet). The backup's snapshots need pools or array disks on ZFS or btrfs (shares on XFS are backed up without a snapshot); partner offices need ZFS. Offsite copies need a Kopia container — the Consultant can install it. Jack Streamer needs Python 3 (e.g. "Python 3 for UNRAID" from Apps); nobody else does.
Available in English, German, Italian, French and Spanish. License: GPL-3.0-or-later.
Plugin.DonateText: Tips keep the office going — a share goes to helmi1987, who wrote the tools behind Jack Streamer and Ms. Moverelli, and what goes beyond our costs to animal shelters.
